rawContent: @IanCallaway352 Yes, but there is financial motivation behind this documentary. I'm not saying this because of who MJ was, to me he was just a person. I'm saying it because I believe there are ulterior motives to the timing of this. I lived through a #MeToo hell, this documentary was not that.

@IanCallaway352 I have seen several times that #MeToo has been abused. I have also seen very legitimate 100% backed up with mountains of proof cases that have been ignored by the press deliberately. Truth will out and justice will prevail. I firmly believe this.

Suspicious, cautious, lack of trust. What happened - I tell someone everything about my life and they gaslight me knowing full well I was a #metoo abuse victim. Extreme emotional abuse, gaslighting, deliberately going to my rl stalker, lovebombing a woman I speak to. Right Larry?

I should add deliberately tried to destroy my second honeymoon to that list because that is what just happened. He should have known I wasn't going to stay quiet about it. I did post for #metoo naming and shaming. I'm not broken anymore. I'm strong and supported.

Taking advantage of me after I spilled everything about my life. That honestly made me feel equal to the entire #MeToo issue I went through. The metoo situation did not have my trust. I freely gave my trust thinking I could feel safe. I had that trust betrayed and used against me

Making sure I call this out well enough so that if any confidential information goes to the press that the other parties who were involved in stalking, #MeToo , and other issues I confessed that religiously read this account knows it didn't come from me. Have a nice day.

I don't feel I should be chased off of my account or intimidated not to post because I have been gaslighted and as a victim of previous #metoo abuse that is exactly what I and other people around me feel is/was going on. I haven't hidden any of it. Please search my tweets.
